title: Unit tests for JSON export
description: Write automated unit tests to verify JSON export produces valid JSON with complete diagram model and no credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests verify JSON export is valid JSON
Unit tests verify JSON contains complete diagram model
Unit tests verify JSON contains no credentials
resultEvidence: Created src/serialization/json-export.test.ts with 17 unit tests across 3 describe blocks:

- AC1 'valid JSON' (5 tests): payload serializes to valid JSON, round-trips through JSON.parse, empty diagram produces valid JSON, top-level version field equals DIAGRAM_JSON_VERSION, top-level diagram root object present

- AC2 'complete diagram model' (8 tests): diagram id and name included, all tables with position/size included, all columns with data types/keys included, all relationships between tables included, all unique constraints included, all indexes from all tables included, ISO 8601 timestamps included, empty arrays for constraints/indexes on empty diagram

- AC3 'no credentials' (4 tests): no credential fields in serialized payload, no credential field names in JSON string, injected credentials on diagram object stripped, no credential leakage nested inside tables/columns
Commit: 6c46f4dd5da2afd4e448eb6e71fd8ec575c29b1a 'TASK-028: add unit tests for JSON export' on branch ticket/TASK-028 (348 insertions, 1 file created)
Unit tests run in Docker container (node:20-alpine, docker compose -f docker-compose.unit.yml run --rm tests): 385 passed across 30 test files, 0 failures
All 4 acceptance criteria verified: valid JSON (AC1), complete diagram model (AC2), no credentials (AC3), all tests pass (AC4)
Lint: src/serialization/json-export.test.ts passes with no errors or warnings
